scope: Offline retained development metadata and explicitly selected original contexts

authority.runtime_input_pins: Executed packet helper plus reservations/receipt, census, prior-exposure packet and annotation manifest
exclusion_order: Authenticate reviewed helper and metadata inputs

Retain pointers and unresolved parent status without inventing absent parent nodes

Propagate exclusions and exposure over complete known metadata components

keys.recording_family_namespace: Recording family and duplicate-group graph nodes retain the catalog/local namespace

artist_coverage_challenge.selection: Seeded rank chooses up to K eligible components for each safe artist; selected components are included whole

probability_sample.selection: Uniform pseudorandom sample without replacement of n eligible whole metadata components
probability_sample.component_and_source_inclusion_probabili: n / number of selection-eligible retained metadata components
probability_sample.population: Permitted retained development frame after all known exclusions and bridges
probability_sample.seed: Preregistered 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits; retain before inspecting selection

union.purpose: Operational allowlist only; panel overlap retained

unknowns: Full named artist roster outside the safe permitted metadata

capture.output: New ignored directory with complete originals.jsonl and completion manifest
capture.raw_gate: Pinned selected_originals reads bytes for all physical lines but decodes only selected permitted lines

recovery: A failed write has no complete manifest. Preserve the partial directory; use a new directory for a retry.
